pairs.subject: chat-transcript
pairs.evidence: src/features/companions/athena/chat/next/frame/variants/fusion/Transcript.tsx:129 Athena's live turn is a separate StreamingTurn element at the foot of the list, and when it settles a different TurnRow reply takes its place, which is exactly the live-bubble swap the turn-model technique names: selection, the scroll anchor and the entrance animation are all lost at settlement.

techniques.evidence: src/features/companions/athena/chat/next/frame/variants/fusion/Transcript.tsx:129 Turns are keyed by a stable message id (key={turn.id}, from the ask's id in exchange.ts), but streaming and settled are two different elements. The live one sits outside turns.map and is replaced by a Reply inside TurnRow.

src/features/companions/athena/chat/next/frame/variants/fusion/Composer.tsx:78 Enter-submit while busy does reach sendOrQueue (queue or interrupt). But ChatInputBar passes busy to the Send Button as loading, and Button sets isDisabled = disabled || loading, so the send control is disabled while a turn runs. There is also no separate interject intent: a classifier picks between queue and interrupt.

src/features/companions/athena/chat/next/frame/variants/fusion/Transcript.tsx:140 There is a pin-while-at-foot follow with a forgiving 96px threshold (line 78) and a jump-to-latest pill, but the pill carries no unseen count. Open-at-latest waits on a double requestAnimationFrame, a proxy rather than a check that layout has settled. Switching threads always lands at the bottom, so per-thread position is not restored (athenaChatSession.ts).

src/features/companions/athena/chat/next/frame/variants/fusion/Transcript.tsx:52 Approvals and chat cards are answered on a DecisionStage that flies in over the app, not as rows in history. The turn carries only a summary chip that opens that separate surface. Machine rows do stay at their turn's position, through MachineFold.

src/features/companions/athena/chat/next/frame/variants/fusion/StreamingTurn.tsx:39 The settled reply goes through one door (AssistantProse to MarkdownRenderer, with sanitizeExternalUrl and code-block actions, TurnRow.tsx:83). While streaming, though, markdown is stripped to plain words instead of parsed with provisional closure, so lists and code blocks reflow when the turn settles.

src/features/companions/athena/chat/next/frame/variants/fusion/MachineFold.tsx:47 Live: a beat or phase line plus the OperationalThread. Settled: machine rows fold into an 'N steps' chip that expands in place, and the steps persist per episode (TurnRow.tsx:86), so the collapse changes presentation and deletes nothing.

src/features/companions/athena/chat/next/frame/variants/fusion/TurnRow.tsx:150 Who and when sit in a side gutter, and the fold, summary chip and copy sit in a quiet strip below the prose, never interleaved with it. No cost or duration figures are shown, so there are no predicate rules to break.
